apps.localizedDescription:
An iOS/iPadOS port of Daggerfall Unity, the open-source recreation of The Elder Scrolls II. Free, non-commercial and source-only. You supply your own copy of Daggerfall's arena2 folder; no game data is distributed.

Pre-alpha: expect rough edges. Touch layout, controller and keyboard/mouse support, real travel along roads, and loose-file mods are in. Full instructions and the mod guide live in README-iOS.md in the repository.

versions.localizedDescription:
Pre-Alpha 0.1.9 — Mods on iOS, and Daggerfall Unity 1.1.1

An iOS/iPadOS port of Daggerfall Unity.
Free, non-commercial, source-only, installed by sideloading. You supply your own copy of
Daggerfall; no game data is distributed here.

This release does two things: it brings the port up to upstream Daggerfall Unity 1.1.1,
and it makes mods actually usable on iOS. The mod work is the reason to read further.

Since v0.1.8-prealpha: 418 commits on the branch. 105 of those are merge commits; of the
313 remaining, 264 are upstream Daggerfall Unity work by 23 contributors and 49 are the
port's own.

Upstream Daggerfall Unity 1.1.1

VersionInfo.DaggerfallUnityVersion moves from 1.0.0 to 1.1.1. The practical effect for
players: mods that declare a minimum of 1.1.1 no longer trip the launcher's "incompatible
mods" prompt.

The 264 upstream commits are the community's work, not this port's. Broadly they cover
weapon collision and missile/line-of-sight handling, enemy and static-NPC behaviour, quest
and item serialization fixes, main-quest and guild quest script fixes, one-way staircase
fixes across several cities, tree placement at zone boundaries, font rendering, UI and
tooltip fixes, and mod-loader improvements (mod list search, copy-modlist-to-clipboard,
custom door support). Please read upstream's own changelog for the authoritative list.

Full release notes: https://github.com/Codex64ai/daggerfall-unity-ios/releases/tag/v0.1.9-prealpha
